title: 第17章 前往铁手盟第18章 铁手盟的考验
lines: 地底基地的沙盘暗了下去，合金地面又变回一片冰冷平整。刚才还铺满整个东大陆的那些腐烂地脉、割据的势力、危险暗域，全都消失了，只剩下寂静的气流在空旷的舱室里慢慢流动。
沈砚站在原地，目光看向三人，声音又冷又硬，没有半句废话：
“铁手盟独占了中部最核心的地盘，握着东大陆最后一片适合居住的好地方，大部分旧时代留下的资源都被他们控制了。盟主周铁山是白手起家，三年就扫平了中部所有零散势力，硬扛兽潮、筑稳城墙，是现在唯一有实力稳住局面的枭雄。”
他说话极其简短，句句都戳在废土最底层的规则上。“但这人野心极大，不信天命、不顾百姓，只相信强权和实际利益。现在他被西边不断扩大的辐射灾难、还有成群的变异兽潮死死拖住，好几年都没办法。这是你们唯一能和他谈条件的筹码，也是你们能进去见他的唯一机会。”
陆寻的指尖无意识地轻蹭着手心，信使的感知始终保持着低度展开。觉醒之后，并没有那种虚浮的力量暴涨，只有一种扎在心里的稳定。他彻底褪去了常年紧绷的焦虑，也更看透了这乱世博弈的本质：空讲大义没人会信，只有结果，才有话语权。
“我明白。”陆寻微微点头，眼底一片平静，语气清醒而通透，“光说救世、空谈大义，打动不了他。我只跟他算利弊、谈存亡、稳霸业，只聊他放不下、离不开的东西。”
沈砚点点头，抬手递过来一枚哑光的铜令。令牌手感沉实，边缘被岁月磨得圆润，表面刻着极其简练的十字纹路——这是传承者三百年不变的信物，没有一点花哨，只藏着实实在在的分量。
“这令牌，能让他压下本能想杀人的念头，给你们一次见面机会。”
“就这一次。”沈砚语气突然转冷，带着十足的警告意味，“见面之后，再没任何依靠。博弈、谈判、是生是死，全靠你们自己。传承者不插手势力争斗，前面是合作的机会，还是必死的杀局，没人知道。”
这是废土最残酷也最公平的规则。没有偏袒，没有优待，所有选择自己承担，所有生死自己负责。
“一次，就够了。”
陆寻接过铜令，仔细收进贴身的地方。动作稳、准、利落，这是在绝境里求生，刻进骨子里的本能——重要的东西，永远贴身藏好，绝不外露。
苏野早已检查完了枪和弹药，枪身擦得锃亮，弹匣压得满满的。他站得像杆枪，肩背绷紧，周身绕着常年厮杀沉淀下来的肃杀气场。不用多说，他永远是队伍最前面的那道壁垒。
林小满放缓呼吸，精神感知均匀地铺开。细腻、柔和、消耗很低，没有任何攻击性，只负责辨别异常波动、预判危险。她是全队最稳的预警线，也是这片冰冷废土里仅存的一点温暖牵绊。
三人之间有种沉静的默契，不需要再多嘱咐。
告别沈砚，他们走进了通往地面的上行通道。
狭长的合金通道隔绝了外面一切声音，冷白的灯光明明暗暗，把三个人的影子拉得又长又扭曲。墙上布满了细密的划痕和旧的撞击凹痕，都是三百年岁月留下的印记。空气干燥微凉，混着岩石的土腥味和金属的锈气，干净整齐，和外面那污浊混乱的废土气息完全是两个世界。
通道尽头，厚重的弧形合金闸门缓缓升起。
齿轮咬合的沉闷机械声落下，刺眼的白昼强光猛地照了进来。紧接着刮来的，是粗糙浑浊的风，裹着辐射的微腥、枯草的焦涩、还有远处变异兽嘶吼的残响，扑面而来——这是最原始、最真实的废土味道。
三人走出地下锚点，彻底回到了混乱的地表。
身后的闸门闭合锁死，隔断了最后一片安稳的净土。前面没有退路，身后没有依靠。
天空铅云低垂，整片荒野阴沉压抑。望不到边的枯黑草木蔓延向远方，地面干裂斑驳，被辐射侵蚀出的灰白死斑随处可见。远山被常年不散的尘雾模糊了轮廓，天地间一片死寂荒芜，看不到半点活气。
这里是东大陆中部荒野，铁手盟势力范围的外围缓冲带。
没有正面战场的血腥搏杀，却处处弥漫着慢性死亡的窒息感。稀薄但持续不断的辐射漂浮在空气里，细碎紊乱的能量流无处不在，悄悄侵蚀着活人的身体、血脉甚至神智，无声地溃烂。
陆寻稳步向前走，左腿落地扎实平稳，多年的旧伤彻底好了，他终于有了完整、均衡的身体状态。
但他没有半点放松。
废土求生的本能早已刻进骨头，安稳永远是暂时的假象。信使的感知持续扩张，方圆百米内地面的细小裂缝、游离的混乱能量、暗处变异兽潜伏的波动，全都清晰映照出来，无处可藏。
“前面有动静，三十米外有沙鼠窝。”陆寻压低声音，语气平稳冷静地提醒，“数量不多，但废土上没有侥幸，小心点过去。”
苏野瞬间抬枪，枪口锁死枯草丛深处，手指虚搭在扳机上，呼吸压到最轻。
林小满凝神铺开感知，片刻后轻声回应，声音柔软却稳妥：“就三只，能量波动很平和，只是在正常找吃的，没有发狂或聚集的迹象，不用紧张。”
三人没有贸然开枪。
无谓的厮杀只会消耗体力、暴露行踪。陆寻侧身让开，放轻脚步，贴着土坡的阴影安静地穿行。草丛里的沙鼠察觉到人的气息，稍微窜动了一下，并没有追上来。
一瞬间的风险，无声无息地化解了。
这是最真实的废土生存法则：不靠运气躲危险，不靠蛮力硬闯，只靠精准的判断、极致的谨慎、还有常年摸爬滚打磨炼出来的、最底层的求生智慧。
三人一路向西，深入中部腹地。
沿途的景色慢慢变了。荒芜干裂的荒野逐渐退去，取而代之的是被人力反复夯实的硬土路，平整坚硬，没有碎石沟壑——这是铁手盟耗费大量人力物力铺设的主干道。路两边的废墟残骸被清理干净了，杂草铲除，部分旧时代的路基也被修好重新利用。
越靠近核心区，那种乱世的无序感就越淡，人为构建的秩序所带来的压迫感就越重。
路上行人渐渐多了起来。
大多是周边据点来的流民、往来做买卖的货郎、轮换执勤的散兵。个个步履匆匆、神色紧绷，带着幸存者特有的疲惫，但又不像荒野流民那样完全麻木死寂。眼里那点微弱的活气，来自于这片势力范围内独有的、那一点安稳的庇护。
道路两边的开阔地上，蹲满了逃难来的流民。
衣衫褴褛，面黄肌瘦，皮肤上布满了辐射侵蚀的暗沉斑块。他们蜷缩在路边的阴影里，沉默、瘦弱、无力。有人抱着奄奄一息的孩子，有人低头啃着干涩的树皮，有人远远望着铁城的方向，眼里还吊着一丝渺茫的求生希望。
战乱碾碎了家园，灾变逼得人流离失所。他们逃到中部这片相对好的地方，只求一条活路，却连核心城池的门槛都摸不到。
content_en:
The sand table in the underground base darkened, and the alloy ground returned to a cold and flat surface. The rotten earth veins, separatist forces, and dangerous dark areas that covered the entire eastern continent just now have all disappeared, leaving only the silent air flowing slowly in the empty cabin.
Shen Yan stood there, looking at the three people, his voice was cold and hard, without any nonsense:
"The Iron Hand Alliance monopolizes the core territory in the central part of the country, holding the last good place for living in the eastern continent. Most of the resources left over from the old era are under their control. The leader of the alliance, Zhou Tieshan, started from scratch. In three years, he wiped out all the scattered forces in the central part. He resisted the beast tide and built a stable city wall. He is now the only tycoon with the strength to stabilize the situation."
He spoke extremely briefly, and every sentence touched on the lowest level rules of the wasteland. "But this man is extremely ambitious. He doesn't believe in destiny or care about the people. He only believes in power and practical interests. Now he is being held back by the expanding radiation disaster in the west and the hordes of mutant beasts. He has been unable to do anything for several years. This is your only bargaining chip to negotiate terms with him, and it is also your only chance to go in and see him."
Lu Xun's fingertips unconsciously rubbed the palm of his hand, and the messenger's perception remained at a low level. After awakening, there is no such illusory surge in power, only a kind of stability that is rooted in the heart. He has completely lost his constant anxiety, and he has more clearly understood the essence of the game in this troubled world: no one will believe you when you talk about justice in vain, only the results will give you the right to speak.
"I understand." Lu Xun nodded slightly, his eyes were calm, and his tone was clear and clear, "He can't be moved by just talking about saving the world and talking about righteousness. I only talk to him about the pros and cons, about survival, about stabilizing the hegemony, and about things that he can't let go of and can't live without."
Shen Yan nodded, raised his hand and handed over a matte copper order. The token feels heavy to the touch, its edges have been rounded by time, and its surface is engraved with extremely concise cross patterns - this is the token that has remained unchanged for three hundred years. It is not fancy at all, but only contains real weight.
"This token will allow him to suppress his instinctive desire to kill and give you a chance to meet."
"Just this once." Shen Yan's tone suddenly turned cold, with a full warning, "After meeting, there is no longer anything to rely on. Game, negotiation, life or death, all depends on you. The inheritors fight hard without interfering. No one knows whether there is an opportunity for cooperation or a fatal situation ahead."
This is the cruelest and fairest rule in the wasteland. There is no favoritism, no preferential treatment, all choices are made by oneself, and one is responsible for all life and death.
"Once, that's enough."
Lu Xun took the copper order and carefully put it close to his body. Movements are steady, accurate and neat. This is the instinct carved into the bones to survive in desperate situations - important things should always be hidden close to the body and never exposed.
Su Ye had already checked the gun and ammunition. The gun body was polished and the magazine was full. He stood like a gun, his shoulders and back were tense, and his whole body was surrounded by a chilling aura accumulated from years of fighting. Needless to say, he will always be the front line of the team.
Lin Xiaoman slowed down his breathing and spread his mental awareness evenly. It is delicate, soft, consumes very little, has no aggressiveness, and is only responsible for identifying abnormal fluctuations and predicting danger. She is the team's most stable early warning line and the only warm connection left in this cold wasteland.
There was a quiet understanding between the three of them, and no further instructions were needed.
Saying goodbye to Shen Yan, they walked into the ascending passage leading to the ground.
The long and narrow alloy passage blocked all sounds outside, and the cold white lights were bright and dim, making the shadows of the three people long and distorted. The walls were covered with fine scratches and old impact dents, the marks of three hundred years of time. The air is dry and slightly cool, mixed with the earthy smell of rocks and the rusty smell of metal. It is clean and tidy, and it is a completely different world from the dirty and chaotic wasteland smell outside.
At the end of the passage, a thick curved alloy gate slowly rises.
The dull mechanical sound of gears biting fell, and the dazzling daylight suddenly shone in. What followed was a rough and turbid wind, carrying the smell of radiation, the burnt smell of withered grass, and the remnant roar of mutant beasts in the distance. This was the most primitive and authentic smell of the wasteland.
The three of them walked out of the underground anchor point and completely returned to the chaotic surface.
The gate behind him was closed and locked, cutting off the last piece of stable pure land. There is no retreat in front and no support behind.
Lead clouds hung low in the sky, and the entire wilderness was gloomy and depressing. Endless dead black vegetation spreads into the distance, the ground is cracked and mottled, and gray and white dead spots eroded by radiation can be seen everywhere. The outline of the distant mountains is blurred by the dust and mist that persists all year round. The world between heaven and earth is dead and desolate, with no trace of life in sight.
This is the wilderness in the middle of the Eastern Continent, the outer buffer zone of the Iron Hand Alliance's sphere of influence.
There is no bloody battle on the frontal battlefield, but the suffocating feeling of chronic death is everywhere. Thin but continuous radiation floats in the air, and fragmented and chaotic energy flows are everywhere, quietly eroding the body, blood and even the mind of living people, festering silently.
Lu Xun walked forward steadily, his left leg landing firmly and steadily. The old injuries he had suffered for many years were completely healed, and he finally had a complete and balanced body.
But he didn't relax at all.
The instinct to survive in the wasteland has long been engraved in the bones, and stability is always a temporary illusion. The messenger's perception continued to expand, and the small cracks in the ground within a hundred meters, the free chaotic energy, and the fluctuations of mutated beasts lurking in the dark were all clearly reflected, and there was nowhere to hide.
"There is movement ahead, and there is a gerbil nest thirty meters away." Lu Xun lowered his voice and reminded calmly and calmly, "There are not many, but there is no luck in the wasteland. Be careful when passing by."
Su Ye instantly raised the gun, locking the muzzle deep in the dead grass. His finger was resting on the trigger, and he breathed as softly as possible.
Lin Xiaoman concentrated on his perception and responded softly after a moment. His voice was soft but steady: "There are only three of them. The energy fluctuations are very peaceful. They are just looking for food normally. There is no sign of going crazy or gathering, so don't be nervous."
The three men did not shoot rashly.
Useless fighting will only consume your energy and expose your whereabouts. Lu Xun stepped aside, stepped lightly, and walked quietly against the shadow of the slope. The gerbil in the grass noticed the human aura and moved slightly, but did not catch up.
The momentary risk was resolved silently.
This is the most authentic rule of survival in the wasteland: do not rely on luck to avoid danger, do not rely on brute force to break through, only rely on accurate judgment, extreme caution, and the lowest level of survival wisdom honed through years of hard work.
The three of them headed west, deep into the central hinterland.
The scenery along the way slowly changed. The desolate and cracked wilderness gradually receded, replaced by hard dirt roads that had been repeatedly tamped by manpower. They were smooth and hard, with no gravel gullies. This was the main road that the Iron Hand Alliance spent a lot of manpower and material resources to lay. The ruins and debris on both sides of the road were cleared, weeds were eradicated, and some old roadbeds were repaired and reused.
The closer you get to the core area, the less chaotic the sense of chaos becomes, and the heavier the sense of oppression brought by the artificially constructed order.
There are gradually more and more pedestrians on the road.
Most of them were refugees from surrounding strongholds, salesmen going about business, and stragglers who were on duty in rotation. All of them walked in a hurry and looked tense, with the exhaustion unique to survivors, but they were not completely numb and lifeless like the refugees in the wilderness. The faint vitality in his eyes comes from the unique and stable protection in this sphere of influence.
The open land on both sides of the road was filled with refugees fleeing from the city.
The clothes are in rags, the face is sallow and the muscles are thin, and the skin is covered with dull patches eroded by radiation. They huddled in the shadows of the roadside, silent, thin, and powerless. Some people were holding dying children, some were gnawing on dry bark, and some were looking in the direction of Tiecheng from afar, with a faint hope of survival in their eyes.
War has crushed homes, and disasters have forced people to become homeless. They fled to the relatively good place in the middle, looking for a way to survive, but they couldn't even touch the threshold of the core city.
